subHeadline: Not a navigation grid — a verdict on every generation, drawn from real enquiry volume and replacement economics. Every model page answers six questions: which generation is best, which engines to avoid, which engines are most reliable, what replacement actually costs, what fails most often, and whether ownership still makes financial sense.

details.title: Best generation
details.text: The only F-Pace generation (X761), for its strong retained values and the widest safe engine coverage in the range.

details.title: Worst engine to buy without history
details.text: Early AJ200D units without documented chain-tensioner inspection — same caveat as Land Rover's Ingenium diesel.

details.title: Most reliable engine across the range
details.text: The AJ200P/204PT Ingenium petrol — no meaningful weak point beyond routine water pump replacement.

details.title: Highest risk
details.text: None flagged at the model level — F-Pace is the one Jaguar with a clean Safe verdict across every engine variant in our data.

details.title: Best used buy
details.text: A 2019+ F-Pace with full service history — the strongest all-round ownership profile of any Jaguar currently on sale.

details.title: Replacement cost (supply-only)
details.text: £3,000 – £5,800 typical reconditioned supply-only band for core F-Pace engines.

dataNote.label: Data Note:
dataNote.text: Live enquiry data and replacement cost economics power every verdict on this site. Model value bands sourced from major UK marketplaces and [EM-VERIFIED] enquiry database.
